policy: Reviewed OSM semantic type metadata conflicts where SIRUTA legal identity/type is unambiguous, the OSM relation represents the correct UAT geometry, and only OSM legal-type-like tags are stale or incorrect. OSM geometry/provenance is preserved; SIRUTA remains authoritative for legal type.

items.review_conclusion: The OSM boundary identity and county placement match SIRUTA 137363 CEHAL, but its legal-type-like tags consistently describe a town. SIRUTA classifies CEHAL as a commune. Treat the OSM type metadata as stale/incorrect representation metadata and retain the official commune type.

The OSM boundary identity and county placement match SIRUTA 92701 FETEȘTI, but its legal-type-like tags describe a town. SIRUTA classifies FETEȘTI as a municipality. Retain the official municipality type and preserve the OSM tags only as provenance until corrected upstream.

The OSM boundary identity and county placement match SIRUTA 146370 SALCEA, but its legal-type-like tags describe a commune. SIRUTA classifies SALCEA as a town. Retain the official town type and preserve the OSM tags only as provenance until corrected upstream.
